acceptance: One baseline per affected skill is tracked at .skillspector/baselines/<skill>.yaml, generated with `skillspector baseline --no-llm` at the pinned scanner commit, and exists only for skills that have findings.
Every entry is a `fingerprints` entry; `rules: []` in every file (no rule-ID or glob suppression).
Every entry has a specific reason matching the triage record; `rg 'auto-generated baseline' .skillspector` prints nothing.
Scanning each tracked skill separately with `--no-llm --fail-on-findings` and its baseline (when it has one) exits 0 for all 15.
Negative check: for each baselined skill, the suppressed count equals the number of entries in its baseline, and a scan without the baseline reports exactly those findings.

Any difference from the 6 expected findings is triaged in docs/skillspector-triage.md before it is baselined (reported to the semantic-pass record via the leader), and no finding triaged as real is suppressed.
Deferral 1 on this item is promoted to its own item before finish.
